sourcePolicy: Local working tree, tests, diagnostics, scripts, RefPlan5 and local Git history only; no remote Git.

phaseGate.input: Verified Phase 05 schema/provenance, Phase 06 Canonical IR, Phase 08A TargetMachine core and Phase 07 value/liveness contracts.
phaseGate.output: One versioned target-platform support contract for native ABI, stack, memory/atomics, TLS, symbols/sections/relocations, object writing, startup, helpers, debug origins, unwind and EH.
phaseGate.authorityBoundary: The contract records compiler-visible architectural facts and support status only; it exposes no runtime rename/PRF/scoreboard/execution/publication/commit/retire authority.
phaseGate.deterministicFallback: Unknown inputs remain Unknown; malformed metadata is Invalid; unproved ABI, stack, TLS, object, linker, startup, helper, unwind and EH capabilities remain Unsupported. No host/LLVM defaults are imported.

platformContract.supportedAtomics: 32/64-bit, naturally aligned, Generic address space, SequentiallyConsistent
platformContract.tls: Unsupported for every known model; unknown model remains Unknown
platformContract.supportedRelocation: Compiler-internal bundle-relative signed-16 control relocation only; no object/link relocation authority
platformContract.objectWriter: Unsupported with independently versioned feature rows
platformContract.comdatDuplicatePolicy: COMDAT unsupported; ordinary duplicate definitions invalid
platformContract.debug: Canonical native origin mapping Supported; object debug sections Unsupported

prequalificationDiagnostic.cause: The new negative debug-origin test initially named a non-existent IrSourceOriginKind.Imported enum member.
prequalificationDiagnostic.disposition: Test fixture corrected to the existing Llvm origin kind before the implementation commit.

releaseDisposition.defaultEnabledScope: Target-platform identity, deterministic validators, proven atomic/fence/internal-relocation facts and native origin mapping; unsupported ABI/object features remain disabled.
releaseDisposition.releaseDisposition: Qualified as the Phase 09 prerequisite; no object writer or executable publication is authorized. Final release authorization remains Phase 27.

nextDependencyGate.gate: Pin an exact LLVM/LLVMSharp public-C-API toolchain in a separate optional adapter project; validate module/version/triple/DataLayout/platform compatibility and deterministic budgets before Canonical IR creation, with native Core/Native remaining package-free.
